description: Workspace-wide announcement posted by a manager on the Dashboard. Every invited member reads this collection; posting is gated to the manager role in the app (the composer only renders for managers). Newest-first ordering comes from CreatedDate.

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: IAM sub of the posting manager. Duplicates CreatedBy for the same self-documenting reason as DirectMessage.senderId — explicit column, explicit filter.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Announcement text, e.g. 'Hello team, today we are going to prod'.
